'''Koltine''' was a<ref name="Hyperspace" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Hyperspace" /> located within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Koltine system/Legends|same name]]<ref name="TEA" /> as part of the [[Jahilid Drift]] region.<ref name="CSWE" /> More than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]] led a strike force in [[Subjugation of Koltine|conquering]] Koltine and [[Subjugation of the Jahilid Drift|other]] worlds along the Jahilid Drift. Sk'ar's victories there led to a boost in his reputation among Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]].<ref name="Hyperspace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Koltine was first mentioned in "[[Aliens in the Empire]], Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils," a [[2007]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]].<ref name="Hyperspace" /> Although the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' placed Koltine within the Jahilid Drift, which was stated to be an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region,<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Koltine system, and therefore Koltine itself, in grid square L-21 as part of Wild [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] instead.<ref name="TEA" />
